design/design-md.tagline: PostHog's design language as a copy-paste DESIGN.md
design/design-md.overview: This is a DESIGN.md file: a single plain-text design spec that captures PostHog's playful cream canvas with hedgehog mascots and a friendly engineering-blog feel. You drop it into your project and your AI coding agent reads it to generate UI that looks like PostHog — its real colors, fonts, spacing, and component rules, no Figma or screenshots needed. It is one of 70+ brand specs in the open-source VoltAgent/awesome-design-md collection, built on Google Stitch's DESIGN.md concept.
capabilities: Documents PostHog's real tokens: yellow-orange #f7a501 CTA, IBM Plex Sans, plus spacing, radius, and elevation scales
Plain markdown an LLM reads natively — no JSON schema, parser, or tooling to set up
Sits alongside AGENTS.md: AGENTS.md says how to build, DESIGN.md says how it should look
Includes do's-and-don'ts and responsive rules so generated screens stay visually consistent
Works with any AI coding agent (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) and with Google Stitch
useCases: A student vibe-coding a project who wants a polished, PostHog-grade look without being a designer
A developer prototyping a landing page or dashboard and prompting an AI agent to match a known brand feel
Anyone studying how a top product's design system is structured, as a reusable reference
howTo: Open the PostHog DESIGN.md in the VoltAgent/awesome-design-md repo (folder design-md/posthog/DESIGN.md) and copy its contents
Save it as DESIGN.md in the root of your own project, next to your code
Prompt your AI agent: "Build the landing page using DESIGN.md as the design system"
Review the generated UI against the do's-and-don'ts section and ask the agent to fix any drift
Reuse the same DESIGN.md for every new screen so the whole app stays consistent

example.label: Add the PostHog look to your project
example.command:
# from your project root
curl -o DESIGN.md https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VoltAgent/awesome-design-md/main/design-md/posthog/DESIGN.md
# then tell your AI agent:
# "Use DESIGN.md as the design system and build the homepage."

goodToKnow: This is an inspired interpretation of PostHog's public design — a learning and prototyping reference, not official PostHog brand assets, so do not ship it as if it were PostHog.
It is alpha/community-maintained: results vary by agent, and proprietary fonts (it names real ones) fall back to free substitutes unless you license them.
